name: What is a sewer camera inspection?

mainEntity.name: What is a sewer camera inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sewer camera inspection involves inserting a high-resolution, waterproof camera attached to a flexible rod into your sewer lines. This allows our technicians to visually inspect the interior of the pipes in real-time. The video feed helps identify blockages, pipe damage, tree root intrusions, or other issues without extensive excavation. This process provides a clear diagnosis, which is crucial for determining the most effective repair strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sewer camera inspection uses a waterproof camera to inspect the inside of your sewer lines for blockages, damage, or other problems without digging.
